description:
Title: Farming Bot

Players want to create custom farming bots, that help them gather resources.
First you have to find out which resources you want.
Up to 10 resources in parallel can be collected, some resources are more urgently needed than others.
Some resources are required to create tools that are needed to gather other resources (create a custom logic of the dependencies in your game).
After all preferences are collected, your bot starts farming.
Sometimes,  random natural disasters strike and set your bot back.
Whenever some milestones are reached, you are notified.
During farming it is possible to update the list of to be farmed materials (at all times).
After the bot is finished, you should be able to brag to selected friends and/or send them materials.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/farming-bot">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Brag" name="Brag"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Materials" name="Materials"/>
  <bpmn:signal id="Signal_NaturalDisaster" name="Natural disaster strikes"/>
  <bpmn:signal id="Signal_MilestoneReached" name="Milestone reached"/>
  <bpmn:signal id="Signal_ListUpdateRequested" name="Farming list update requested"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_FarmingBot">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Player" name="Player">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Begin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetUrgency</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DefineDependencies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Boundary_ListUpdate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EditList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SharingOptions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Brag</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Complete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_FarmingBot" name="Farming bot">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_StartFarming</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FarmResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Boundary_NaturalDisaster</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplySetback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Boundary_Milestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyMilestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_MilestoneNotified</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SharingJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SharingMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Begin" name="Begin bot setup"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectResources" name="Choose resources to farm (up to 10)"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetUrgency" name="Set resource priorities"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DefineDependencies" name="Define custom tool and resource dependencies"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StartFarming" name="Start bot farming"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FarmResources" name="Collect selected resources in parallel">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false">
        <bpmn:loopCardinality xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">count(selected resources)</bpmn:loopCardinality>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_NaturalDisaster" name="Natural disaster strikes" attachedToRef="Task_FarmResources" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SignalEventDefinition_Disaster" signalRef="Signal_NaturalDisaster"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplySetback" name="Apply natural-disaster setback to bot progress"/>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_Milestone" name="Milestone reached" attachedToRef="Task_FarmResources" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SignalEventDefinition_Milestone" signalRef="Signal_MilestoneReached"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyMilestone" name="Notify player of milestone"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MilestoneNotified" name="Milestone notification sent"/>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_ListUpdate" name="Farming list update requested" attachedToRef="Task_FarmResources" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SignalEventDefinition_ListUpdate" signalRef="Signal_ListUpdateRequested"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EditList" name="Update list of materials to farm"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplyList" name="Apply updated farming list"/>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SharingOptions" name="Select post-farming options"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends" messageRef="Message_Brag"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends" messageRef="Message_Materials"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SharingJoin" name="Complete selected sharing actions"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SharingMerge" name="Continue after sharing"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Complete" name="Farming bot finished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Begin" targetRef="Task_SelectResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_SelectResources" targetRef="Task_SetUrgency"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_SetUrgency" targetRef="Task_DefineDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_DefineDependencies" targetRef="Task_StartFarming"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_StartFarming" targetRef="Task_FarmResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farming_Complete" sourceRef="Task_FarmResources" targetRef="Gateway_SharingOptions"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disaster_1" sourceRef="Boundary_NaturalDisaster" targetRef="Task_ApplySetback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disaster_2" sourceRef="Task_ApplySetback" targetRef="Task_FarmResources"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Milestone_1" sourceRef="Boundary_Milestone" targetRef="Task_NotifyMilestone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Milestone_2" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMilestone" targetRef="EndEvent_MilestoneNotified"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_1" sourceRef="Boundary_ListUpdate" targetRef="Task_EditList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_2" sourceRef="Task_EditList" targetRef="Task_ApplyList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_3" sourceRef="Task_ApplyList" targetRef="Task_FarmResources"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Brag" sourceRef="Gateway_SharingOptions" targetRef="Task_Brag">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">player selects bragging</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Materials" sourceRef="Gateway_SharingOptions" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">player selects sending materials</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoSharing" sourceRef="Gateway_SharingOptions" targetRef="Gateway_SharingMerge" name="No sharing selected" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Brag_Join" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_SharingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Materials_Join" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_SharingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sharing_Complete" sourceRef="Gateway_SharingJoin" targetRef="Gateway_SharingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Complete" sourceRef="Gateway_SharingMerge" targetRef="EndEvent_Complete"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FarmingBot">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot" processRef="Process_FarmingBot"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Brag" name="Brag" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_Brag"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Materials" name="Materials" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_Materials"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
